import re, numpy as np

def parse_grid_section(text, marker='Test input'):
    start=text.index(marker)
    tail=text[start:].splitlines()[1:]
    rows=[]
    for line in tail:
        if not line or not re.match(r'^\d',line): break
        rows.append([int(x) for x in line.split()])
    return np.array(rows,dtype=int)
test=parse_grid_section(text6)
print(test.shape)
for v in sorted(set(test.flat)):
    coords=np.argwhere(test==v)
    print(v,len(coords), coords.tolist())
